hazard.summary: Slack agent converts Anthropic 429 Retry-After into a static user-visible failure despite same-repo SDK retry behavior.
signals: Slack agent returns static overload message
Retry-After not inspected at Slack agent call site
SDK client in same repository parses retry-after seconds and HTTP-date formats
static fallback occurs before retry budget exhaustion

constraints: Provider-supplied Retry-After must be inspected before a user-facing fallback is returned.
Retry-After parsing must support both delta-seconds and HTTP-date formats.
Correct retry primitives must be reused consistently across sibling callers in the same runtime.
A static overload message may only be returned after bounded retry budget exhaustion.
A provider WAIT signal must survive adapter boundaries in machine-actionable form.
verification: Add a unit test that simulates Anthropic 429 with Retry-After: 3 and asserts the Slack agent waits/retries before returning fallback.
Add a unit test that simulates Anthropic 429 with Retry-After as an HTTP-date and asserts equivalent wait parsing.
Add a retry-exhaustion test proving the static overload message is returned only after retry budget is exhausted.
Run a static search for Anthropic 429 handlers that return fallback text without inspecting Retry-After.
Run an integration test with a mocked Slack event where the first Anthropic call returns 429 + Retry-After and the second call succeeds.

constraints: Reuse correct retry primitives across sibling callers.
Return static fallback only after bounded retry exhaustion.

impact.operator_impact: A recoverable provider-side WAIT signal is presented as a failed Slack interaction, causing users or operators to retry manually.
impact.business_consequence: Avoidable user-visible failures and manual retry amplification under provider capacity pressure.

notes: Public issue was closed as part of a stale-issue sweep, not as an explicit technical rejection. Treat this receipt as candidate-quality until current main branch verification confirms the Slack agent path still bypasses Retry-After or a merged patch verifies the mitigation. Pattern match: correct-primitive-unwired-callers.
